_comment: Autism Spectrum Disorder -- Teachers' Diploma syllabus. First typeset 2026-10-12.
Layout and spelling repairs only: NONE of these rewrites a competence, an activity or
an expected standard.
THE MANUSCRIPT HOLDS THE WHOLE SYLLABUS TWICE, one copy pasted after the other. The
two copies are word for word the same EXCEPT for the numbers typed in the matrix:
first copy  -- every number carries a leading '1.' (the year): topic 1.1.1,
sub-topic 1.1.1.1, competence 1.1.1.1.1; Term 2 runs 1.2.x, Term 3 1.3.x;
second copy -- sub-topic 1.1.1, competence 1.1.1.1; Term 2 runs 2.x, Term 3 3.x; topics
unnumbered (but for a stray '1.1.1.1.1.4 NEUROBIOLOGY ...').
The first copy is the one typeset (in the second, Word's lists run on from the first:
the outline restarts at 4, the weightings at 4.7). NUMBERING, checked 2026-10-12: the
matrix is set WITHOUT the leading '1.' -- topic 1.1, sub-topic 1.1.1, competence
1.1.1.1, Term 2 from 2.1, Term 3 from 3.1. That is the second copy's numbering, and it
is the one the manuscript's own course outline (1.1 Topic 1 ... 2.1 Topic 1 ... 3.1
Topic 1) and its own contents list (1.1 FOUNDATION ..., 2.1 INCLUSIVE ..., 3.1
TRANSITION ...) use, in both copies; it is also the family's format. With the prefix the
matrix called Term 2's first topic 1.2.1 where the outline two pages earlier calls it
2.1. Outline and matrix now agree number for number (12 topics, 66 sub-topics).
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* Confirm the matrix numbering (above): the first copy's year prefix was taken off.
* RATIONALE says 'four key pillars' and lists three (1-3).
* ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS still carries the template's own prompt, '(Specify entry
qualifications)'. Set as written.
* TIME ALLOCATION is given twice (front matter, and again after the weightings).
* The level on the cover and divider is 'Teachers' Diploma' (the file name gives no
level). The manuscript's course name says 'Early Childhood Education, Primary and
Secondary Teachers' Diploma'.
* No year and no ISBN yet.

removeRange._why: The second copy of the syllabus (see _comment). Removes everything from the last line of the first copy up to the identical last line of the second, which then closes the book in its place.

The cover's text boxes import as one run-together paragraph (it also carries left-over lines from other syllabuses: 'DESIGN & TECHNOLOGY SENIOR SECONDARY SCHOOL SYLLABUS'), and the contents list is typed by hand with the author's Word page numbers. The engine draws the cover and generates the contents with real page numbers.
removeRange.from: Republic of Zambia MINISTRY OF EDUCATION

setHeading._why: Typed as item I of a one-item roman list; it is the section that opens the body (level divider, arabic page 1) in every book of the family.

replaceBlocks._why: The Acknowledgement's signatory: two bold lines, which set as section headings and were listed in the contents. Set like the Preface's signatory (name bold, office plain). Spelling: 'Curriclum Development Center' -> 'Curriculum Development Centre', as the paragraph above it spells it.

A lead-in with its value after the colon, styled as a heading in Word: it set in tracked capitals and ran to two lines in the contents. Set as a run-in line, as COURSE NAME is in the other books of the family.
replaceBlocks.find: Course Syllabus Name: Autism Spectrum Disorder Education (Early Childhood Education, Primary and Secondary Teachers’ Diploma)

with.para: **Course Syllabus Name:** Autism Spectrum Disorder Education (Early Childhood Education, Primary and Secondary Teachers’ Diploma)

replaceBlocks._why: The line opens with a figure, which the engine hung out as a list number ('2    Years, ...'). (It now opens with a zero-width space.)
replaceBlocks.find: 2 Years, First Year Theory and Second Year Practice and Final Examinations

with.para: ​2 Years, First Year Theory and Second Year Practice and Final Examinations

_deleteExact_why: A line of the hand-typed contents list (removed whole by removeRange below, but only after pageBreakBefore has looked for its anchor -- which this line would otherwise catch).

pageBreakBefore._why: The last line of TIME ALLOCATION ('99 hours for Year One (1)') fell alone on a page of its own. The two closing sections now share a page.
OUTCOMES OF THE PROGRAMME and its first item ('1. Knowledge and Understanding') sat at the foot of p. ix, with the item's text over the page. The section now opens the next page whole.

_remove_why: The signatory's office line, re-set by the replaceBlocks entry above.

setMarker._why: TIME ALLOCATION after the weightings: Word carries the weightings' list on into these six lines (4.3, 4.3.1, 4.3.2, 4.4, 4.5, 4.6 -- '4.4. 3 Hours per Week'). Set with bullets, exactly as the same six lines are in the front matter.

setMarker.find: Second Year Teaching Practice and Examinations

setMarker._why: The weightings took their numbers from the course outline's Word list, which ends at 3 (TERM THREE): 4.1, 4.1.1 ... 4.2. ASSESSMENT METHODS AND WEIGHTINGS is section 5 in the manuscript's own contents list (4 Teaching and Learning Methods, 5 Assessment ..., 6 Time Allocation, 7 References), so they are 5.1, 5.1.1 ... 5.2 -- as the other books of the family number theirs after their section.

editCell._why: The topic's number comes from a Word list whose first level is a roman numeral, so it read 'I.1.2' between 1.1.1 and 1.1.3.
A space typed inside the number ('1. 1.3.3.1'); it follows 1.1.3.2.1 under sub-topic 1.1.3.3.
editCell.find: 1. 1.3.3.1 Address institutional challenges affecting autism services.
editCell.with: 1.1.3.3.1 Address institutional challenges affecting autism services.

editCell._why: Spelling: the first letter of IDENTIFICATION typed over by the number's full stop ('1.1.5.DENTIFICATION').

The year prefix: a leading '1.' typed in front of every topic, sub-topic and competence number of the matrix (see _comment). Taken off, so the matrix carries the numbers of the course outline and of the second copy. Must stay LAST in this list: the three entries above put right numbers that still carry the prefix.

edit._why: Course outline: the topic's own number left out ('1.2. Topic : Autism Across Cultures', between Topic 1 and Topic 3).
Course outline: the colon left out, alone among the twelve topic lines.
